items.html: And likewise that Eheyeh of Yudin descends and is clothed in the second Eheyeh of Alfin, which is in the three middle ones, whose place is in its Tifferet, at the place of the chest, and there the two of them join and become the breasts for her. Therefore these two Eheyehs, in their two fillings, in Yudin and in Alfin, are numerically equal to Shaddai (shin-dalet), to hint that from them the breasts are made.
